text.Awal Mula PT Erajaya Swasembada Tbk: The Beginnings of PT Erajaya Swasembada Tbk
text.Perjalanan Erajaya berawal pada 1992 dar: Erajaya's journey began in 1992 from a small shop on Jalan Rawa Bahagia 1 No. 12, Grogol, West Jakarta. Four years later, in 1996, the company was officially established with a focus on distributing and retailing technology products, especially mobile telecommunications devices. From there, Erajaya grew into an importer, distributor, and retailer of mobile devices recognized as one of the largest and most trusted in Indonesia.
text.Pada 2007, Erajaya membuka gerai erafone: In 2007, Erajaya opened its first erafone store, which later became the backbone of its retail network. In 2011, PT Erajaya Swasembada Tbk was listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (ticker ERAA). The company then expanded through acquisitions, namely iBox in 2012. In 2014, Erajaya acquired CG Computer Sdn Bhd in Malaysia, owner of the Switch brand, an Apple Premium Reseller and Apple Authorised Reseller, with 23 retail stores by the end of that year. In 2016, the first Urban Republic store in Indonesia opened.
text.Pada 2018, Erajaya Group meluncurkan lay: In 2018, Erajaya Group launched its Omni Channel service, integrating offline and online business through O2O services. Its network includes erafone, iBox, Urban Republic, Samsung Experience Store, and erafone.com. In 2019, Eraspace was launched, an omnichannel retail platform that unites online and offline shopping, together with the MyEraspace loyalty program to strengthen customer engagement.
text.Pada 2021, Erajaya membentuk tiga vertik: In 2021, Erajaya formed three business verticals: Erajaya Digital, Erajaya Active Lifestyle, and Erajaya Food & Nourishment. This step transformed Erajaya from a mobile device retailer into a lifestyle retail and distribution ecosystem bringing many global brands to Indonesia. Erajaya Digital: erafone & more and Erablue (2022), the first Apple Premium Partner and the 100th iBox store (2023), Samsung by erafone and expansion into Papua (2024), a partnership with HONOR, 20 years of iBox, the 80th erafone & more store in Bandung as the largest in Indonesia, and the first stand-alone iBox Apple Premium Partner in Southeast Asia (2025). Erajaya Active Lifestyle: the first JD Sports in Indonesia and a partnership with ASICS (2022), MST Golf Arena and Shokz (2024),
text.Paris Baguette pertama di Indonesia (202: The first Paris Baguette in Indonesia (2021), Bacha Coffee and Wetzel’s Pretzels (2024), and CHAGEE (2025).
text.erafone & more dan Erablue (2022), Apple: erafone & more and Erablue (2022), the first Apple Premium Partner and the 100th iBox store (2023), Samsung by erafone and expansion into Papua (2024), a partnership with HONOR, 20 years of iBox, the 80th erafone & more store in Bandung as the largest in Indonesia, and the first stand-alone iBox Apple Premium Partner in Southeast Asia (2025).
text.JD Sports pertama di Indonesia dan kerja: The first JD Sports in Indonesia and a partnership with ASICS (2022), MST Golf Arena and Shokz (2024), and the XPENG, Wilson, and ANTA flagship stores (2025). JD Sports also expanded to Bali (2024) and Kalimantan (2025).
text.Per 30 September 2024, Erajaya memiliki: As of 30 September 2024, Erajaya had 42 distribution centers, 2,099 retail stores, and about 54,000 third-party outlets billed directly, spread across Indonesia, Singapore, and Malaysia. Besides mobile device distribution and retail, the company offers value-added services such as TecProtec phone protection and handset leasing. Its head office is at Erajaya Plaza, Jl. Bandengan Selatan No. 19-20, Pekojan, Tambora, West Jakarta. Source: Erajaya – History and Erajaya – Company Profile

text.XPENG di Indonesia berada di bawah Eraja: XPENG in Indonesia operates under Erajaya Active Lifestyle (ERAL) as the Sole Agent and Brand Holder (ATPM). Dealers are run together with local dealer partners under two concepts: 1S (sales) and 3S (sales, spare parts, service). In June 2025, ERAL targeted six initial locations in Greater Jakarta and about 12-15 showrooms in the following year. As of mid-2026, Autofun reported that the showroom network had reached 8 operating points.
